documents.notes: The preamble explicitly states that assuming supreme authority, rights and powers in Germany does not constitute annexation. This distinguishes an occupation/control footprint from Soviet sovereign territory. Used to exclude the isolated East Berlin component mistakenly included in the secondary USSR archive, not to alter the USSR mainland frontier or the separate Königsberg settlement.
